simulator.name: Gazebo (OpenAMRobot, headless, WSL)
simulator.description: Gazebo Harmonic with ROS 2 Jazzy in the WSL distribution openmhs-ros, running openAMRobot/openamr-platform-sw's own simulation. Runs one at a time; each needs about 1.5 GB of memory and a few minutes.

scenarios.title: OpenAMRobot: stop after command loss (#79)
scenarios.description: Headless Gazebo run of upstream's command-timeout scenario: the base is driven at 0.2 m/s, the command publisher is killed after 4 s of simulation time, and the travel afterwards is measured from Gazebo's world pose for 5 s. 'fix' runs the fix branch as committed; 'main' swaps in the two wiring files from origin/main (the pre-fix wiring) for the run and restores them.

wiring.description: main: pre-fix wiring from origin/main. fix: the #79 fix as committed.

outputs.name: travel_after_kill_m
outputs.description: Base travel after the command publisher was killed (Gazebo world pose)
